summary: Turn any industry into a daily intelligence briefing. An AI agent searches, filters, writes, and delivers structured daily briefs to 9 channels — with machine-checked formatting and a business review gate. Ships with a Data+AI profile out of the box; switch to any domain via config. 中文摘要：行业日报生成器——AI agent 搜索、筛选、编写并投递结构化每日简报至 9 个渠道， 含机器格式校验与业务评审门禁。触发词：行业日报、每日情报简报、自动日报、daily brief.
